en: the situation when somebody has to leave their job because there is no more work available for them
ex: Thousands of factory workers are facing redundancy.
数千名工厂工人面临裁汰。

en: without a job because there is no more work available for you in a company
ex: to be made redundant from your job
成为冗员而被裁减

en: in an unnecessary way
ex: Data are redundantly stored in multiple different locations.
数据冗余地存储在多个不同的位置。

en: to make a copy of something in order to form another of the same kind
ex: These cells are able to reduplicate themselves.
这些细胞能自我复制。

en: (used about words) repeating a syllable or other part of the word, often with a slight change
ex: Reduplicative expressions like ‘mishmash’ and ‘nitty-gritty’ illustrate the playful nature of English.
像 mishmash 和 nitty-gritty 这样的叠声词显示了英语俏皮的一面。

zh: brought back into use or made popular again
en: brought back into use or made popular again
ex: The 1980s were far more than just the 1950s redux.
1980年代不仅仅是1950年代的革命。

zh: 红杉，红木（多生长于加利福尼亚州和俄勒冈州）
en: a very tall type of tree that grows especially in California and Oregon
ex: giant redwoods
巨大的红杉树
